title: Concept: Tomcat manager application reachable
description: The Tomcat Web Application Manager page in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The manager deploys WAR files, so reaching it with any credential lets an attacker upload a shell that runs with the container's identity.
applicability: Deployments that render the Tomcat Web Application Manager page into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The manager deploys WAR files, so reaching it with any credential lets an attacker upload a shell that runs with the container's identity.
